items.text: W2 injury beneficiaries: McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman/Moore; AJ Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Kamara=Kendre Miller; Sampson=Raheim Sanders; Stribling=Deebo.
Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance return Week 2 or 3 per coach; same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise. Scary history but day-to-day.
items.why: Meniscus trim; coach optimistic, realistic W2 chance per reports.
items.implication: Monitor practice; TE1 if active, Mayer fills if not.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (rib) day-to-day per HC Harbaugh; monitored this week, status up in air for Week 2 vs Raiders after exiting W1.
items.why: Rib injury; further eval, practice will decide.
items.implication: GTD; if OUT, Tre Harris primary beneficiary.

items.text: A.J. Brown placed on IR with high ankle sprain; expected 4-6 weeks (more serious side). Out min 4 games.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed more severe; IR.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week amid Commanders opportunities (Stribling injury context).
Malik Nabers returned limited (36/69 snaps 52%, 24/34 routes 71%) but efficient: 9 targets 31% share, 6-69. Encouraging post-ACL/meniscus; healthy finish.
items.why: High efficiency on limited snaps/routes in first game since Sept 2025.
items.implication: Ramp-up expected; strong WR1/2 outlook as snaps increase.
items.opportunity: Target share elite even limited; more volume coming.

items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on IR (knee); signed Jaleel McLaughlin. Out at least 4 games.
items.implication: Judkins lead but low routes noted; Sanders/McLaughlin depth.

items.text: Rashee Rice saw only 2 targets (7% share, 2.5 aDOT) despite 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks; career tiny aDOT (4.9) means he needs volume that Walker-centric offense may not provide. Knee not 100% possible factor.
items.why: Routes present but targets collapsed; offense conservative/run-heavy.
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR now riskier; monitor for trailing/zone scripts.
items.opportunity: Routes high but targets suppressed by Walker presence.
items.conflict: High route participation vs low target share.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in Chiefs debut, 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec on 6 targets (22% share) and 19 routes on 33 dropbacks. True workhorse role confirmed vs prior Seattle committee concerns.
items.why: 29/32 early opps + high target share in debut; forced 14 missed tackles.
items.implication: Elite RB1 with workhorse + receiving upside; handcuff Emmett Johnson must-own.
items.opportunity: Near-monopoly carries + routes/targets in KC offense built around him.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Kendre Miller/CJ Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4. Surprising committee.
items.why: Failed to seize full workload in absence.
items.implication: Committee risk persists; Miller handcuff/beneficiary value.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious (would've returned in playoff); day-to-day, MRI but optimistic. Coach confirms.
items.implication: Likely plays W2 or limited; monitor.

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full-grown man after MNF explosion; #MondayNightMiracle love.
Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 dropbacks W1 even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early; Browns used Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low pass-game involvement despite teammate injury.
items.implication: More runner than receiver; ceiling capped without routes.

items.text: Panthers RB: Chuba Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps; Jonathon Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks had early-week groin tweak.
items.why: Hubbard lead but Brooks involved; tweak noted.
